extraction.title: Parties
extraction.detail: Buyer: Alpina Pumps AG (Winterthur). Supplier: SinoGear Ltd (Ningbo).

extraction.title: Term
extraction.detail: 3 years from the Effective Date, then 1-year auto-renewals.

extraction.title: Unit price and currency
extraction.detail: USD 48.50 per MH-200 housing, FCA Ningbo.

extraction.title: Price adjustment
extraction.detail: Annual adjustment 'in accordance with Annex C'. Annex C is not attached, so the mechanism cannot be read.

extraction.title: Delivery schedule
extraction.detail: Delivery 'within a reasonable period' after call-off; no lead time is defined.

extraction.title: Warranty
extraction.detail: 6 months from delivery, defects in material and workmanship.

extraction.title: Delay damages
extraction.detail: 0.5% of delayed value per full week, capped at 2%.

extraction.title: Liability cap
extraction.detail: Aggregate liability limited to 10% of the prior 12 months' purchases.

extraction.title: Termination rights
extraction.detail: For cause: 30-day cure period. For convenience: either party, after year 1, on 180 days' notice.

data.value: cause: 30-day cure; convenience: 180 days after year 1

extraction.title: Governing law
extraction.detail: Swiss law excluding CISG; ICC arbitration seated in Zurich.

benchmark.title: Warranty below market
benchmark.detail: 6-month warranty; comparable custom-component supply agreements in the benchmark set show 12-24 months.

benchmark.title: Delay damages cap below market
benchmark.detail: Cap of 2% of delayed value; benchmark range 5-10%.

benchmark.title: Discretionary annual price changes
benchmark.detail: Annex C lets the supplier reset prices yearly at its discretion; market practice is index-linked adjustment with a cap.

benchmark.title: Liability cap below market
benchmark.detail: 10% of annual purchases; benchmark median is 100% of annual contract value.

risk_screening.title: Price can rise at the supplier's discretion
risk_screening.detail: Annex C allows a yearly reset with no index or cap, which conflicts with the client's priority of stable prices.

risk_screening.title: No acceptance inspection
risk_screening.detail: Without an inspection window, defects may only surface after the 6-month warranty has run.

risk_screening.title: Hold-up after redesign
risk_screening.detail: Alpina redesigns its pumps around these housings, but the supplier owns the dedicated tooling and is not obliged to keep supplying (forecasts non-binding).

risk_screening.title: Warranty claims may be uncollectible
risk_screening.detail: SinoGear's financial standing is unknown and there is no parent guarantee or bond.

redlines.title: Index-linked price escalator
redlines.detail: Replace discretionary price resets with an annual adjustment linked to a published producer-price index, capped at +/-5%.

data.proposed_text: The unit price is adjusted once per contract year by the change in the Swiss producer price index (PPI) over the preceding twelve months, capped at +/-5%.

redlines.title: Acceptance inspection window
redlines.detail: Add a 30-day inspection window with replacement at the supplier's cost.

data.proposed_text: Buyer may inspect each delivery within 30 days of receipt. Non-conforming goods are replaced or credited at Supplier's cost.

redlines.title: Higher delay damages and shortfall discount
redlines.detail: Raise delay damages and add a price discount on short deliveries, following the shortfall-gas precedent.

data.proposed_text: Delay damages: 1% per week, capped at 10%. Quantities short-delivered against a confirmed call-off are invoiced at a 15% discount.

redlines.title: Minimum supply commitment and tooling ownership
redlines.detail: Supplier commits to supply forecast volumes; title to dedicated tooling passes to the buyer if the contract ends.

data.proposed_text: Supplier shall accept call-offs up to 120% of the rolling forecast. On expiry or termination, title to the MH-200 tooling passes to Buyer against payment of its net book value.

redlines.title: Parent guarantee or performance bond
redlines.detail: Secure warranty and delay claims with a parent guarantee or a bank bond.

data.proposed_text: Supplier shall deliver a parent company guarantee or an on-demand bank performance bond of 10% of the annual purchase value.

negotiation_priorities.title: Benchmark: price escalator caps
negotiation_priorities.detail: Index-linked escalators in the benchmark set are capped between +/-3% and +/-8% per year.

negotiation_priorities.title: Benchmark: tooling transfer
negotiation_priorities.detail: Tooling typically transfers at net book value, or free of charge once amortised over the term.

negotiation_priorities.title: Benchmark: delay damages
negotiation_priorities.detail: Market range 0.5-1% per week, capped at 5-10% of the delayed value.
